claim: When importing an engine onto a newer main, rebuild on main first and compare bytes before trusting earlier proofs; judge each main-only change against the branch's base.

evidence.text: A shared stub piece had moved (436 bytes) when rebuilding on main.
Upstream by checking main's copy equals the branch's base, then judging each main-only fix.
Engine files byte for byte the frozen release sources, so both builds are byte-identical and the proof carried.
An approved build made before the new defaults rebuilds only with the record's pin.
A pilot's change to the shared boot model goes into the engine on import.

next_check: After an import, compare the rebuild byte for byte with the MD5 recorded before it and name each shared file that differs.
